sites.name: 布尔萨
sites.periodLabel: 奥斯曼早期都城
sites.checklistItem: Bursa and Cumalıkızık: the Birth of the Ottoman Empire
sites.identityLabel: 奥斯曼早期都城
sites.identityEnLabel: Early Ottoman capital
sites.identityNote: 布尔萨于1326年成为奥斯曼早期都城。迁往埃迪尔内的具体年份存在资料差异，以约1360年代表示，不将征服埃迪尔内的年份直接当作迁都年份。遗产八组件不是全城边界；朱马勒克兹克村是乡村支撑组件，不是另一座都城。希萨尔内堡、贝伊宫及整个奥斯曼城市尚未取得可靠完整墙界，当前保留可核实遗存和参照点，不推造宫城或全城面。官方资料有五座主要城门与包含附加门的六座口径，现代修复不等于全部原物。
sites.identityEnNote: Early Ottoman capital from 1326 to approximately the 1360s; transfer dates differ between sources. UNESCO components are not a complete city boundary. Complete inner-citadel and palace boundaries remain unverified.

sites.name: 安卡拉
sites.periodLabel: 加拉太古都、罗马行省首府与土耳其共和国首都
sites.identityLabel: 加拉太古都／土耳其共和国首都
sites.identityEnLabel: Galatian capital / capital of the Republic of Türkiye
sites.identityNote: 安卡拉在公元前3世纪成为加拉太特克托萨格斯部的都城，后为罗马加拉太行省首府；行省首府身份不单独作为国家都城记录。1923年10月13日安卡拉被正式宣布为土耳其共和国首都。UNESCO预备名单坐标是乌卢斯—克孜勒伊历史与现代城市轴线的城市参照点，不是古城、城堡、现代行政区或任何时期完整城界。 已接入OSM明确标为城市城墙的现存标绘段及Akkale轮廓；各段缺少可靠内外墙归属，不进行主观拼接。
sites.identityEnNote: Capital of the Galatian Tectosages and, since 13 October 1923, of the Republic of Türkiye. Roman Ancyra was a provincial capital. The UNESCO Tentative List reference point is not a complete city boundary.

sites.identityNote: 图伦王朝都城，与福斯塔特、阿斯卡尔及969年建立的法蒂玛开罗分址。图伦王朝868—905年；本记录为9世纪后期至905年的都城阶段，不把王朝起年直接当作建城年。根点以伊本·图伦清真寺所在历史核心作区域参照；不是已确认王宫位置。现仅接入清真寺建筑外缘及庭院孔洞，不代表全城、宫城或城墙；完整分期城界和宫殿遗存范围待核。
sites.identityEnNote: Tulunid capital, distinct from Fustat, al-Askar and Fatimid Cairo founded in 969. The dynasty lasted 868–905; this record covers the late ninth-century capital phase to 905 without equating dynastic accession with city foundation. The root references the historic mosque core, not a verified royal palace. The mosque footprint and courtyard hole are preserved; they are not city, palace or wall boundaries. Complete dated city and palace limits remain unverified.
sites.wallBoundaryReview: 已接入清真寺原始建筑面；完整城郭及宫城范围待核

sites.identityEnNote: Kish comprises several mounds including Uhaimir and Ingharra. The dated city-state is distinguished from later temples. Unidentified short OSM castle_wall traces are excluded rather than promoted to a city circuit.
